description: E2E acceptance criteria for Test-EndToEndDeployment.ps1. Defines the pass/fail gate for each child test script, the overall deployment gate order, and the conditions under which a completed run is considered a successful service entry.

overallGate.description: A deployment is considered E2E-passing when ALL required gates pass, AND the evidence package is complete, AND there are no outstanding MANUAL_ACTION items in the deployment evidence.
serviceEntryBlockers: Any required gate is in FAIL or SKIP state
Open Items Register contains an unresolved item in status Blocked or Open that is tagged as service-entry-blocking
Bootstrap account Owner assignment has not been removed and confirmed
At least one workload in customer-intake.json has not reached 'validated' state

gates.description: Validates local environment prerequisites: Az modules, repo paths, schema files, and existing Az session.
passCriteria: Az.Accounts, Az.Resources, Az.SecurityInsights modules present at minimum required versions
mssp-management repo path accessible if local deployment mode
customer-intake.schema.json and onboarding-state.schema.json present
Active Az session in the correct managing tenant
failActions: Stop pipeline — no further scripts should run until prerequisites are satisfied

gates.description: Verifies Azure Lighthouse delegation is active and that ARM cross-tenant access is functional for the customer subscription.
passCriteria: managedByTenantId matches the expected RSOC managing tenant ID
At least one expected Lighthouse authorization (principalId + roleDefinitionId) resolves in the delegated subscription
ARM GET on the customer subscription succeeds from the managing tenant context
ManagedByCount >= 1 for the customer subscription
failActions: Record which expected authorization principals are missing
Log delegation status and ARM error to evidence
Halt pipeline — Sentinel workspace and content deployment depend on Lighthouse

gates.description: Confirms RSOC role assignments are correct and Sentinel workspace is reachable.
passCriteria: Sentinel workspace exists in the expected resource group and subscription
Microsoft.SecurityInsights/onboardingStates/default exists
RSOC automation identity has Microsoft Sentinel Contributor or Sentinel Reader as configured
SecurityIncident query succeeds with 0 or more results (no API error)
No unexpected Owner or Contributor assignments on the subscription (advisory — logged but does not auto-fail)
Logstash service principal has Monitoring Metrics Publisher ONLY — not Owner/Contributor
failActions: Sentinel workspace missing or unreachable is a hard fail

gates.description: Validates Tenant Governance (GDAP) relationship is active and Defender MTO tenant is visible.
passCriteria: At least one active Tenant Governance relationship exists for the customer tenant
Relationship includes at least the minimum approved security roles (see rbac-baseline.json)
Customer tenant visible in Defender MTO portal for approved RSOC personas
Tenant Governance relationship is not in Pending or Inactive state
advisoryCriteria: If GDAP Defender unified RBAC roles are not yet GA, record advisory — do not hard-fail (OI-G01 tracking)
failActions: Record relationship state and role set to evidence
Relationship in Pending/Inactive state is a hard fail
Missing minimum security role set is a hard fail

gates.description: Confirms bootstrap onboarding account state at service entry — should be in closure state.
passCriteria: Bootstrap account is disabled OR deleted in the customer tenant
Bootstrap account Owner assignment on the subscription has been removed
No other direct Owner assignments exist for non-approved principals
MFA was confirmed active during bootstrap window (evidence from onboarding record)
advisoryCriteria: If bootstrap account is still active (pre-closure check mode), record its UPN, license, and MFA state without failing
failActions: Bootstrap account still Owner on subscription at service entry is a hard fail
Record account state and last sign-in to evidence

evidencePackageRequirements.description: Files that must exist in the evidence/ directory before a service entry pass is declared.

ownerRetentionModel.description: Expected Owner assignment state at E2E gate — must be validated by G05.

expectedOwners.principal: CUSTOMER emergency Owner group (affiliate-local security group with RSOC B2B users)

contentDriftGate.description: Invoke-ContentDriftRemediation.ps1 with -Remediate must produce 0 failed items before service entry.
contentDriftGate.note: Content drift gate is advisory at initial service entry. It becomes required at first 30-day review.
